svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Container option only; a rented shed needs none.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four lengths, each 3005 x 300 mm, from 4.5 mm tread plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Laid end to end along the seam with 4 mm gaps; the four lengths

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: run the full 12,032 mm between the end walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer both long edges 2 mm at 45 degrees so trolleys roll over.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and countersink 6.5 mm holes along ONE long edge only, 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in from the edge, 150 mm from each end and at 300 mm pitch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: centre on the seam, screw down with M6 x 40 countersunk wood

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws into the floor of the intake-side container only, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two containers can move a little without tearing the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate lies flat with no edge more than 1 mm proud.
